journalEntries.text: I've been feeling overwhelmed with work lately. The deadlines keep piling up and I can't seem to catch a break. I'm starting to question if I'm good enough for this job.
Had a really good conversation with my friend today. It made me realize that I've been isolating myself too much. I need to reach out more to people I care about.
I keep procrastinating on important tasks and then beating myself up about it. This cycle is exhausting and I don't know how to break it.
